title: Create Aeronautics Expanded | Core
description: The best multiplayer-friendly well-optimized Create Aeronautics modpack without unrelated mods ! Regularly updated !
body:
## About This modpack brings together the best Create: Aeronautics addons to deliver a smooth and enjoyable gameplay experience. Unlike other modpacks, this one focuses only on Create. It stays lightweight, clear, and easy to understand. **Why "Core"?** Because it works with popular mods and Create schematics, letting you expand and build whatever you imagine. The core of this modpack is built around [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and [Create: Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics). **Why "Expanded"?** Because it adds more content on top of the base experience and pushes what you can build even further. The only limit is your imagination. Worried about missing newer vanilla features? No problem. [Vanilla Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport) brings modern Minecraft updates into your world without changing the core feel. > "Not bigger, better. The core is the foundation of a great Create experience." ## What does it add? And why you should install it:
Spoiler It adds new ores, weapons, blocks (like thrusters, for example), decorations, functionality, and much more. Big Cannons, Armored Constructs, Create Propulsion: Simulated, JetPacks | _**===== Perfect for warships, planes, jets, rockets, and more! ========**_ World Edit, Sable: Edit, Create: Copycats and Create: Copycats Weighted | _**Make realistic builds with beautiful textures & shapes**_ Create: Deco, Create: Crafts & Additions, Create: Diesel Generators, Create: Coasters Simulated, Create: Interiors, Dyeable Components & Ropes | _**Expand your technology empire and decorate your creations!**_ Aeronautics Camera Sync, Gyro Stabilizer, Tweaked Controllers, Liquid Fuel, Create: Connected, Sable Hose Connector, Transmission & Linkage, Climbable Ropes | _**Small and big tweaks that will enhance your experience**_ Xaero's World Map and Minimap, Waystones, JEI, Jade, LambDynamicLights, Dynamic Sounds, Create: Addon Organizer | _**QoL (Quality of Life) improvements!**_ With Aeronautics Wind Sound, Aeronautics Discovery, and Create/Aeronautics structures, _**your world will become even more immersive!**_ With Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, FastNoise, C2me, Clumps, AsynchParticles, _**enjoy a smooth and optimized experience!**_ Contains various compatibility mods for storage and other popular mods. This is not the full mod list.
## Information - You need to install the modpack on both the server and client side for it to work. Most mods are customizable. - For any suggestions or to report bugs, go to my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/JjZfVHQ8Zy). I will update this project regularly. - The name "Create Aeronautics Expanded | Core", logo, and branding are reserved. (Don't use the exact same logo and name — be creative.)
FAQ **Is this AI ?** AI was not used to generated anything here, everything was made by humans. It is only used for grammar correction and faster debugging. It's a tool like any other. **I found a bug, what do I do ?** First of all, it's normal if you find a bug. We are a small team, therefore we can't test every feature. Please report any bug [here](https://discord.gg/JjZfVHQ8Zy), thanks. **Is it multiplayer-friendly ?** Yes ! You can even host worlds for free thanks to [World Host](https://modrinth.com/mod/world-host).
Credits All credits go to the actual owners of each mod. This modpack includes many excellent mods created by talented developers. Please support the original creators on Modrinth and their project pages. This license applies only to the original files of the modpack (configs, scripts, documentation, custom assets, and others). Included third-party mods remain the property of their respective authors under their own licenses. Thanks to [FancyMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/fancymenu) and [Aeronama](https://modrinth.com/mod/aeronama), which I used for the custom main menu. Special thanks to the Minecraft modding community. Also, go check out [arthursimao567](https://modrinth.com/user/arthursimao567)'s [modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/create-physics-and-aeronautics): he made that nice title ( the old one ) (and the logo!). The new title is made by [The Tophatted Dolphin](https://www.youtube.com/@the_tophatted_dolphin) Which i will be linking his youtube channel instead of Modrinth because... it has more stuff
**Do NOT reupload this modpack** to other platforms like CurseForge — it will be taken down. **Art (logo, title, banner...) is _All Right Reserved._**
